about: Harvested commit (or npm version) of every source of the compatibility corpus, phase H (2026-11-15). A later re-harvest diffs each repository from `commit` to its new HEAD and adds the new rule ids / change types / tests to the checklists of this directory. Fixtures are re-authored, never copied; no document was sent to a hosted service.

sources.used: checker/rules.go rule ids (checklist oasdiff-rules.json), checker/*_test.go, diff tests, testdata pairs; lifecycle / sunset rules as annotation cases (POLICY-07)
what-changed/model tests; what-changed/model/breaking_rules.go default rules (checklist libopenapi-breaking-rules.json)
sample-specs fixtures, cmd tests (OpenAPI and the AsyncAPI rules it takes from libasyncapi)
